title: date hint ppkkvvvv calendar optional focus trap
name: Date hint always visible; calendar optional — Suomi.fi
rule: Date hint `PP.KK.VVVV` (or `p.k.vvvv`) always visible; calendar optional; focus is trapped while the calendar is open. Dual-cite USWDS typeable date / GOV.UK memorable date.
pass_when: Date format hint is always visible; the field is typeable; calendar (if present) is optional and traps focus while open.
fail_when: Date format is only in a placeholder; calendar is the only entry path; calendar open without focus trap.
overview: Date format hints stay always visible; the calendar is optional and traps focus while open.
apply_when: Building typeable date inputs with an optional calendar overlay.
not_when: Calendar-only entry with no typing path, or format living only in a placeholder.
agent_hint: Keep PP.KK.VVVV hint visible, allow typing, and trap focus while the calendar is open.
description: Suomi.fi date inputs keep a `PP.KK.VVVV` (or `p.k.vvvv`) hint always visible, remain typeable, and treat the calendar as optional with focus trapped while it is open. Dual-cite USWDS typeable date and GOV.UK memorable date. Hiding the format in a placeholder, making the calendar the only entry path, or opening the calendar without a focus trap fails the pattern.
do_not_claim: Time `t.mm` row; USWDS typeable / GOV.UK memorable as a merge that drops the Finnish hint + trap.
